core_meaning.literal_meaning: The name is the Persian word itself, used unchanged as a given name rather than a derived or diminutive form.
core_meaning.meaning_explanation: Shirin corresponds to the Persian form شِيرِين (Persian شیرین (shīrīn)). Its core sense is shirin; sweet (persian). Shirin is Persian شیرین (shīrīn), meaning 'sweet'. It is used as a female given name in Iran, Central Asia and South Asia.
